hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it handles the entire swap: taking input tokens, depositing them into an Euler vault, and withdrawing output tokens from another Euler vault, settling with the PoolManager via beforeSwapReturnsDelta. Verifies a proprietary bonding curve invariant on each swap. Blocks standard Uniswap v4 liquidity provision and donations.
